content.text:
I checked everything in the Chat Input spec that "anchor" could refer to against the code. All of it already matches, so I didn't change anything this time.

- **Chain tab bottom border:** the spec now says Chain never has a line along its bottom. The code draws no line under it in any tab selection, and `the_chain_has_no_bottom_line` passes. That covers your instruction that the anchor button must have no bottom border, if the anchor button is the Chain tab.
- **Hidden anchor, escaping:** prompts and system prompts are written line by line as quoted text and references, so pasted braces, quotes, colons, fences and backslashes arrive exactly as typed. `pasted_prompts_are_taken_as_they_are` and `saved_source_parses_back` pass.
- **Hidden anchor, auto imports:** what the language server sees blanks everything outside references except letters, digits and spaces, position for position. `the_lsp_draft_blanks_everything_but_references_and_words` passes.
- **Hidden anchor, attached text:** each piece is stored as quoted lines. The harness receives it after an "Attached text:" line, each piece in a code fence longer than any run of backticks inside it. `attached_text_is_taken_as_it_is` passes.
- **Compiling:** a hidden anchor compiles against this project's own spec with the real `piton`, and previews compile without keeping any files. Both tests pass.

All 11 hidden-anchor tests and both Chain tab tests pass.

If you meant a different "anchor", such as the lock-to-bottom button in the scroll column or something in the chat input I haven't named, tell me which and I'll pick it up.
